title: Grateful Dead Live at Dillon Stadium on 1974-07-31
source: source: aud cassette master; taped by Jimmy & Laurie Cooper; sony ecm22p’s > hitachi trq-222; tdk sd-c90, (2)tdk ed-c90’s, 4 starr c-90; nakamichi dragon > benchmark adc1 24/96 > mac > adobe audition cc > fission > 16/44.1 > xACT flac; power by furman p-2400; transfer & mastering - Rob Berger

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience bootleg that captures a clear Wall of Sound performance with crisp instruments, heavy bass and recognizable vocals.
ai_review.review: The single fan review praises this cassette‑sourced audience recording as an unusually clean capture of a Wall of Sound show just after the Mars Hotel release. All instruments are described as clear, the bass as heavy, and the vocals as recognizable, making it a very listenable bootleg despite its tape origins.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review but it gives a perfect 5‑star rating and highlights both strong musical performance and high‑quality audio for an audience tape, justifying a high overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear instrument separation, heavy bass, recognizable vocals; minor cassette imperfections noted but overall very few flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific set‑list comments; reviewer notes the show is solid and enjoyable as a typical Wall of Sound performance shortly after Mars Hotel's release.
